note: Tested clean-room 2.5D CAM subsets. FUNCTIONAL entries are not claims of complete PowerMill parity or multi-axis machining support.

capabilities.name: Tool library and geometry parameters
capabilities.reference_behavior: Define endmills, ball mills, and drill bits with flute counts, surface speeds, and tooth feeds.
capabilities.expected_output: Calibrated tool instance stored in tool library
capabilities.differences: Flat endmill, ball endmill, and drill bit definitions verified.

capabilities.name: Spindle speed RPM and cutting feed rate calculation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Calculate spindle RPM from surface speed (Vc) and table feed from chip load (fz) and flute count.
capabilities.expected_output: Exact RPM and mm/min feed rate

capabilities.name: Raster zig-zag 3D area clearance
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generate parallel zig-zag passes with configurable stepover and stepdown across stock boundaries.
capabilities.expected_input: Stock bounds, stepover, stepdown, Z top and bottom
capabilities.expected_output: Ordered cutting and rapid reposition moves
capabilities.differences: Tested zig-zag scanline clipping, cutter-radius clearance against convex selected boundaries, and exact first/bottom stepdown levels. Surface projection, rest machining, and 3-axis collision avoidance are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Parallel offset contour clearing
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generate concentric offset boundaries for smooth continuous engagement roughing.
capabilities.differences: Tested exact inward offsets for strictly convex planar selections. Concave boundaries, islands, adaptive engagement, and surface offsets remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: Pencil finishing along intersection corners
capabilities.reference_behavior: Trace intersection corners using ball endmills to remove rest material.
capabilities.differences: Traces the cutter-offset boundary at floor depth. Automatic surface-intersection and rest-material corner detection remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: RS-274 CNC G-code post-processing
capabilities.reference_behavior: Post-process toolpath movements into standard CNC G-code with G00/G01/G02/G03, spindle M03, and safety blocks.
capabilities.differences: Tested generic absolute metric and unit-converted inch G0/G1, spindle, tool-change, dwell, and program framing after path validation. Machine-specific kinematics, canned cycles, macros, probing, and controller certification are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Selected planar geometry, tool clearance, depth, and post validation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Drive operations from selected model geometry, reject unsafe or inconsistent parameters, and post only verified paths.
capabilities.expected_input: Convex planar boundary, stock, cutter, depth range, stepover/stepdown, and selected drill centres
capabilities.expected_output: Cutter-centre paths clipped and offset within the selection; invalid tools, depths, clearances, and hole centres rejected
capabilities.performance: Linear in polygon edges per offset or scanline; convex boundaries only
capabilities.differences: Covers validated 2.5D convex boundaries and explicit hole centres. Full solid/mesh contact, holder collision, gouge checking, fixtures, and arbitrary topology are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Editable CAM project persistence and history
capabilities.reference_behavior: Persist an editable CAM project and provide undo/redo for setup and operation changes.
capabilities.expected_input: Stock, tools, boundaries, editable operation parameters, and document mutations
capabilities.expected_output: Validated reopened project with regenerated paths and reversible edits
capabilities.performance: Snapshot history; calculated moves are regenerated on open
capabilities.differences: Schema-v1 native persistence and product-local history are tested. It is not PowerMill project-format compatible, does not store arbitrary CAD models, and does not provide collaborative or PDM history.

capabilities.name: Persistent desktop CAM authoring workflow
capabilities.command: CREATE / OPERATION; APPLY / REGENERATE; FILE / EXPORT
capabilities.reference_behavior: Author and inspect machining setups through a project browser, operation properties, and interactive machining viewport.
capabilities.expected_input: Desktop selection, property edits, viewport navigation, save/open, and NC export
capabilities.expected_output: Engine-backed stock, tools, boundaries, regenerated toolpaths, native project, and posted NC file
capabilities.performance: Interactive CPU path inspection for tested 2.5D project sizes
capabilities.differences: Qt workflow, property-driven regeneration, top/isometric stock and path display, selection, undo/redo, save/reopen, and export are tested. The viewport is not stock-removal simulation and lacks direct boundary-vertex editing, solid-model import, GPU rendering, machine simulation, and multi-axis verification.
